originality.rationale: Full relevant primary texts arxiv:2604.04922v1, arxiv:1707.04130v1 and arxiv:2511.10347v1 inspected. Original paper proves marginal signed-position FCLT, correction limit; Bercu gives separate superdiffusive memory; Shibata samples parity-specific rather than full-history labels. No checked source contains the jointly independent Brownian and strictly anticorrelated memory/correction theorem. General mixing martingale CLT alone does not provide model-specific covariance sign. Indexing and equivalent-results priority risks remain.
residual_risks: An unindexed equivalent joint limit or residual covariance formula could exist in a generalized urn martingale/elephant-walk analysis.
The independent Brownian factor uses a standard mixing consequence of the martingale FCLT; the nontrivial additional result is the model-specific residual anticorrelation.
A general theorem with stronger coverage of the same *global-history* model, if found, could alter priority.

value.rationale: A complete joint two-timescale limit of natural observables of one global-history elephant walk answers whether normal-looking dihedral location fluctuations retain statistical information about the superdiffusive memory. The Gaussian factor decouples from the complete residual pair even though the residual amplitude and correction are strictly negatively correlated for every superdiffusive interior parameter. This supplies a structural dependence distinction and a global sign classification, not merely a marginal CLT, numerical sample, or arbitrary parameter slice.
